verdict.rationale: BigQuery offers a free sandbox that needs no credit card or billing account. A monthly free tier (10 GiB storage, 1 TiB queries) also exists, and Dataform supports developing and testing transformations. Custom daily quotas and dry-run byte estimates help contain dev costs. However, the sandbox is explicitly 'limited' and positioned for evaluating fit rather than as a dev environment, and all work still runs on cloud compute. Missing for 10: a local engine or emulator for offline/fast iteration, documentation of the sandbox as an isolated dev/test loop for transformations, and independent hands-on corroboration of a dev workflow.
